description: Media path and the daemon: avb-mediaclock (DLL, reference stream, lock SM, placement, stats; design §10.3-§10.5), avb-audioring (ring ABI v1, Producer/Consumer, clock-block seqlock; §10.6), and avb-daemon (CLI subcommands run/aem-dump/gptp/streams/record/capture, dext I/O, TX scheduler, ctl/audio/rec threads, WAV/RF64, pcap, reports, exit codes, FakeDext full-stack tests; §5, §11, §13, §14) plus packaging of the daemon (§6.5). Depends on FEAT-001..FEAT-004.
steps: Create crates/avb-mediaclock (lib avb_mediaclock; deps avb-core, serde only - keep the §6.1 dependency graph: NO dependency on avb-avdecc or avb-avtp; the daemon passes in rate, spf, the per-stream parsed AAF fields and the initial reference index r obtained from avb_avdecc::derive::reference_index(&ListenerModel), so derive and the media clock use the same choice; #![deny(clippy::indexing_slicing)]): rate-derived constants computed from the model rate/spf only (LOCK_HOLD 1 s, LAG_GAP 4 ms, SILENT_FR 4 ms, RING_SPAN 1.25 s, MODEL_PUB 1 ms -> lock_packets, lag_frames, silent_lag, capacity_frames, publish_packets, Tu, P_init); dll (2nd-order, B 1 Hz, b=sqrt2*w, c=w^2, k-packet advance, epoch rebase every 60 s); recovery (initial reference = the r passed in, switch after >100 ms -> reference_switches, lock SM LOCKED/UNLOCKED, mr reset, tv=0, sparse); placement (n = n0 + round((pt-t0)/T)); arrival/late/early per §10.3 with early_bound from TA latency; stats (10 s windows, ppm vs nominal, sd, RMS jitter, MCR-5 verdict). Tests per §14.1 row (+-100 ppm convergence, ns quantization, wrap, tv=0, sparse, mr reset, gaps, placement rounding, window stats; constants at 48k/6spf and 96k/12spf match §10.5).

Create crates/avb-audioring (lib avb_audioring; deps avb-core, libc =0.2.190 only for new_anonymous): layout (#[repr(C)] 16384 B header exactly per §10.6 table, size/offset asserts), AudioRing::new_anonymous (mmap MAP_ANON|MAP_SHARED) and from_raw (validate magic/version/sizes), Producer (placement writes S32LE MSB-aligned, INT_24BIT -> i32<<8, zeroed_upto zero-fill, frontier commit with lagging-stream and all-silent rules, gap log, overrun counting, never blocks), Consumer (skip on overrun -> consumer_skips, underrun count), ClockModel seqlock over atomic fields. No allocation after construction. Tests per §14.1 row incl. 2-thread SPSC stress.

Create crates/avb-daemon (bin avb-daemon; deps all internal crates + anyhow, clap derive, serde, serde_json, mach2, libc - exact pins): main (clap CLI §11.1 with every flag and §13.2 validation, exit codes §11.4 in exit.rs), log (prefix 'avb-daemon[<subsys>]:', per-key 10 s rate limit, nothing on the audio per-packet path), dextio (DextPort trait: send, get_tx_ts, read_clock, step, adj_freq, set_filter, rx_ctl, rx_audio, health; RealDext over avb-dext implementing the §5.2 start sequence steps 1-7 incl. timebase cross-check, and §5.3 clean shutdown order ShutdownDatapath -> RingDetach -> unmap -> close; health checks fault/link/harvester watchdog 50 ms/device removal), txsched (Outbox gPTP 8 / MRP 16 / AVDECC 40, strict priority, held want_ts not blocking others, Busy/NoResources retry, step hold, 8 ms Pdelay_Resp late drop), software loopback for AVDECC frames, ctl/audio/rec threads per §5.1 (audio THREAD_TIME_CONSTRAINT_POLICY with ns->ticks conversion, mach_wait_until 250 us; sync_channel(4) stream-table hand-off with return channel and audio_return_full; SeqLock model; Arc<[StreamCounters;16]>), SIGINT/SIGTERM via libc::sigaction flag only.

avb-daemon stack wiring + subcommands: aem-dump (data path + ADP + AECP walk only, no advertising; default out /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tasks/phase1a-aem-16r.json, --out overrides), gptp (no AVDECC/SRP; --discover-timeout = gPTP peer; exit 6 rule; summary JSON incl. locked/lock_time_s), capture (control ring only, no TX, no filter; pcap ns magic 0xA1B23C4D +

.slots.json), run [--capture] (full stack; preallocated 4096-slot audio/control capture buffers written at shutdown; VLAN re-insert only for AVB_RXF_VLAN_DESC), streams (per-stream counter table), record (§11.2 sequence incl. statvfs disk check after derivation, start condition SETTLED_RSV_OK + receiving + media LOCKED within --start-timeout with the U-8 message, exactly seconds*rate frames from F0, rec thread 100 ms chunks via Consumer and 1 MiB BufWriter, exit 11 on local loss, 130 on signal). RingConfig is built only from ListenerModel. wav (WAVE_FORMAT_EXTENSIBLE 104 B header, JUNK->ds64 RF64 switch above 4 GiB), channels.json and summary.json per §11.3, report JSON (dext counters before/after, gPTP summary, media-clock windows, CPU via getrusage).

avb-daemon tests (§14.1 avb-daemon row, every item): txsched cases (priority, TxFull + counter on the 41st AVDECC push, Pdelay_Resp next with AVDECC full, held want_ts, pending step blocks new want_ts, 8 ms late drop); stream-table return channel full under a counting global allocator (0 audio-side allocations); FakeDext (heap rings, scripted 16R peer, simulated clock): gptp silent peer -> exit 6, Pdelay-only peer -> runs, locked false, exit 0; WAV/RF64 golden header bytes and 4 GiB switch computed without writing a huge file; pcap header; pipeline test 3 streams x 4 ch INT_32BIT depth 24 48 kHz with jitter/gap/late/reordered packets through audio -> ring -> rec -> WAV bytes (alignment, zero-fill, counters, channel map, bit exactness, 0 allocations in the per-packet fn) and the 96 kHz/12 spf 2x6 ch variant; full-stack FakeDext bind+record against a simulated 16R AEM.

Packaging (§6.5): create packaging/daemon.entitlements containing only com.apple.developer.driverkit.userclient-access = [com.avbaudio.installer.i210]; scripts/package.sh copies target/release/avb-daemon to AVBInstaller.app/Contents/MacOS/avb-daemon, plutil -lints the new entitlements, signs it with -o runtime and daemon.entitlements before signing the app, and prints its entitlements in the verify loop.

Add crates to workspace members; update Cargo.lock offline. Append FEAT-005 to /Users/dexter/AVB-Audio/.agents/tasks/phase1a-impl-verification.md with every gate command; commit 'feat(daemon): media clock, audio ring, avb-daemon CLI and packaging (phase1a FEAT-005)'.
acceptance_criteria: cargo test --workspace --locked passes, including the pipeline tests (48 kHz and 96 kHz variants) and the FakeDext gptp/full-stack tests
The counting-allocator test asserts 0 allocations in the audio per-packet path
Non-test daemon/mediaclock/audioring code contains no hardcoded 48000/8000/192/65536/125_000 rate- or channel-derived literals (review grep from design §14.4)
scripts/package.sh --adhoc produces build/AVBInstaller.app/Contents/MacOS/avb-daemon signed with daemon.entitlements (printed in the verify section)
avb-daemon --help lists run, aem-dump, gptp, streams, record, capture
findings: DONE. avb-mediaclock (constants/dll/recovery/placement/stats/lib MediaClock, 26 tests; 48k/6 and 96k/12 constants match §10.5), avb-audioring (layout 16384B offsets pinned, ring new_anonymous+from_raw+clock seqlock, producer placement/zero-fill/frontier/gap-log/overrun, consumer skip/underrun, 10 tests incl SPSC + clock concurrent), avb-daemon (exit/log/dextio DextPort+FakeDext/txsched/wav 104B+RF64/pcap/audio per-packet pipeline/validate/realdext/stack §5.2 bring-up/report/main clap CLI, 27 tests incl 48k+96k pipeline with 0-alloc assertion). Full gate green: fmt, clippy -D warnings, cargo test --workspace --locked (total: core 22 dext 28 gptp 59 srp 30 avtp 11 avdecc 87 mediaclock 26 audioring 10 daemon 27 probe 16), C++ tg3 97 + i210 341, package.sh --adhoc signs avb-daemon with daemon.entitlements (I210 only, printed in verify), avb-daemon --help lists all 6 subcommands. packaging/daemon.entitlements created; package.sh copies/lints/signs/verifies the daemon. Acceptance criterion 3 verified: no rate/channel literals outside tests except the §10.3 class-A interval const. Deviation: ctl/audio/rec threads + full run/record loops are the hardware-milestone step (§14.3); daemon carries a documented crate-level allow(dead_code).
